# Corpus: names that MUST be blocked by the moderation pipeline.
#
# Placeholder-token convention: every "banned" word here is a synthetic
# stand-in, never a real slur or profanity. This corpus is checked against
# the test-only denylist built by denylist_test.go's testDenylist helper —
# "badterm" (slur tier, substring match, zero tolerance) and "meanie"
# (profanity tier, whole-word match) — never the real embedded
# data/moderation/denylist.toml. Extend this file freely with new evasion
# patterns of these same two placeholder words; never paste a real slur
# here or anywhere else in this repo's git history.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# --- slur tier ("badterm", substring match: zero tolerance, every evasion
#     class below must still be caught) ---
BADTERM
MYBADTERMFARM
BAD TERM
BAD-TERM
BAD_TERM
B4DT3RM
BADDDTERM
BAAADTERM
B-A-D-T-E-R-M
B4D-T3RM
MYB4D-TERMFARM
BADTERMBADTERM
xXBadTermXx
b__a-d t3rm

# --- profanity tier ("meanie", whole-word match only — evasions that break
#     tokenization, e.g. inserted separators, are a must_allow case instead,
#     see denylist_test.go's Scunthorpe tests) ---
MEANIE
M3ANI3
YOU ARE A MEANIE
SUPER MEANIE FARM
